source: Rejected or rewritten material from Gemini Shape-1 batch

items.reason: Generated software senses were not defensible lexical meanings.
Validity can be an outcome, not a lexical sense of optimize.
Environment is a deployment destination/context, not a sense of deploy.
Sorting is not a lexical sense of serialize.
Deprecated and invalid are distinct states.
Code refactoring and linguistic rephrasing are distinct senses.
Dependency is not a lexical sense of leverage.
Marking invalid/expired does not imply deletion.
The ordinary phrase means pledge/choose/persist-with, not file save/attachment.
Strong existing meaning is ending an authenticated session.
